overview: The story of four young women from different social classes who navigate the challenges of adolescence while trying to break into the arts. The girls will face off against Federico Cantú, who is trying to claim the inheritance of one of their fathers.
title: Muchachitas

overview: Consuelo lives a life with very little love, and she doesn't believe that she will ever find the love of a man. But on a trip to Paris, Consuelo meets Julio Navarro, a brilliant doctor who immediately discovers in her a beautiful, intelligent and strong woman who only needs a little love. Together with Julio, Consuelo will face her family, but Teresa and Carlos will not give up so easily and will continue trying to dominate and destroy her and thus be able to take control of her family inheritance.
title: Pobre niña rica

overview: Vera de Almeida Barreto highlights her choices as a woman dedicated to family, sacrificing herself to support her husband's career and raise their three children. Upon discovering Lourenço's affair with lawyer Daniela Lopes, a younger woman, Vera reevaluates her life, questioning her role as a woman and facing a lack of support from her children in this challenging situation. The plot becomes even more complex when Vera falls in love with a younger man, challenging societal norms and exposing the double standards surrounding age differences in relationships.
title: Nunca Digas Adeus

overview: Two twin brothers are separated at birth, one living a millionaire life and the other a simple life, after an accident both exchange their lives.
title: Amores de Mercado

overview: A caravan of gypsies arrives in Mejillones, Chile, to celebrate the marriage of their king, without imagining that the repentant arrival of his daughter after two decades, will revive a stormy past.
title: Romané

overview: This is a love story in which there are different ways of feeling it. Carolina belongs to a middle-class family. She lives with her parents and her two sisters and she has a boyfriend named Mario. In college, he accidentally meets Pablo, a young man who appears in an affair with his girlfriend
title: Amores querer con alevosía

overview: Muchachitas como tú follows the story of Isabel, Elena, Mónica, and Leticia—four young women from vastly different backgrounds and social classes who meet at an arts academy to study acting, dance, and singing, sharing the dream of achieving success and overcoming life's adversities to find happiness.
title: Muchachitas como tú

overview: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.
title: Route 187

overview: For Lisa Giordano Navarro, midlife is messy. At 50, she crashes head-on into a moment when the years she's lived meet the years she has left - and it scares her. So she blows up her life for a chance at a do-over.
title: Middlehood

overview: A 50-year-old cartoonist with five kids and aging parents faces a mid-life crisis, complicated by a hernia. His physical limits force him to reflect on freedom, family duties, and what matters most.
title: El Resto Bien

overview: Set on a future Earth, Defiance introduces players and viewers to a world where humans and aliens live together on a planet ravaged by decades of war and transformed by alien terra-forming machines. It centers on Jeb Nolan, the law-keeper in a bustling frontier boomtown that is one of the new world's few oasis of civility and inclusion. Nolan is a former Marine who fought in the alien conflict and suffered the loss of his wife and child in the war. The trauma transformed him into a lone wanderer in the wilds of this new and dangerous world.
title: Defiance

overview: Based on the characters and story from the best-selling novel by Stephen King, The Dead Zone is a unique psychological thriller that combines a rich mix of the paranormal, action, and a continuing quest for justice.
title: The Dead Zone

overview: Shadows is a British Supernatural television anthology series produced by Thames Television for ITV between 1975 and 1978. Extending over three seasons, it featured ghost and horror dramas for children. Guest actors included John Nettleton, Gareth Thomas, Jenny Agutter, Pauline Quirke, Brian Glover, June Brown,Rachel Herbert, Jacqueline Pearce and Gwyneth Strong. The series was also notable for reviving the character of Mr. Stabs. Notable writers for the series included J. B. Priestley, Fay Weldon and PJ Hammond.
title: Shadows

overview: Comedy Inc. was an Australian sketch comedy television series featuring predominantly send-ups and impersonations of well known personalities and TV Shows.
title: Comedy Inc.

overview: The series will bring to the screen the emotionally charged story of Ali and Zeynep, whose paths cross around the same child after a great loss eight years ago. Woven with secrets from the past, a custody battle, and great sacrifices, the series will take the audience on a compelling journey.
title: Anne Yarısı

overview: The small town of Wari Pasop appears peaceful, but beneath its calm surface lie dark secrets and buried truths. Years after a woman mysteriously disappeared, a series of brutal murders brings the old case back to life. When Pin arrives in Wari Pasop searching for her missing sister Pan, she instead discovers the body of a powerful man's son. As the police investigate, Pin becomes entangled with Jeans, a mysterious newcomer whose secrets may be connected to the murders. As the investigation unfolds, the town's seemingly ordinary residents become suspects, and trust becomes increasingly difficult. Everyone appears to have something to hide, while the truth behind the disappearances and killings draws closer to the surface.
title: Still Water

overview: Eugenia is a bitter businesswoman who has two daughters. She loves one, Raquel and despises the younger one. The "whim" that the titles refers to is Eugenia's decisions to protect Raquel that end up blowing up in her face.
title: Capricho

overview: A passionate story where love does not respect traditions and usually breaks with the patterns of the time, all framed in the Chilean nitrate Pampa Ilusión.
title: Pampa ilusión

overview: In 1962, the small town of San Andrés is governed by morality and good manners, the arrival of a new nun will come to change everything.
title: Estúpido Cupido

overview: In the 1960s, the lives of several Catholic school students unfold as they romance, party to the American rock and roll craze, and live through high society's prejudices of the times.
title: Estúpido Cupido

overview: Tells the story of a coastal resort in some corner of Chile, ruled by Don Federico Valdivieso, a scoundrel mayor, and with the desire to achieve his only goal: a cemetery for his city.
title: Sucupira

overview: The every day life and relationship between the rather curious residents of a block of flats in the center of Athens.
title: Η Πολυκατοικία

overview: Dino Dan is a Canadian/American television series for children. It is shown on TVO Kids in Ontario, Nick Jr. in Australia and the US, and CITV in the UK. Dino Dan follows the adventures of a ten-year-old paleontologist-in-training, Dan Henderson, and his friends, who uncover clues about the past and secrets of the dinosaurs. The show combines live action with CGI dinosaurs. Dan learns about dinosaurs as he conducts experiments on "dinosaurs" that he sees in his environment. It is unknown if they are real or the result of his active imagination, but other characters accept that Dan sees them. Some animals, such as Dan's dog, have also seen them, and in the episode "Dino Trackers", Dan's younger brother can also see the dinosaur tracks.
title: Dino Dan

overview: In a town towards the south central of Chile, a strange mystery occurs, for years only women are born.
title: Aquelarre

overview: Los Pincheira follows four siblings who form a legendary band of outlaws to seek justice against the tyrannical landowners responsible for their father's wrongful execution.
title: Los Pincheira

overview: El Circo de las Montini tells the story of Olga Primera Montini—the matriarch and owner of a circus troupe setting up in San Antonio—as she prepares to hand over control to one of her four daughters, all while a past love reappears, bringing with him secrets from the past.
title: El Circo de las Montini

overview: Decision House is a reality television series in which couples enter on-camera therapy to save marriages. It debuted on MyNetworkTV in September 2007 and aired for only one season.
title: Decision House

overview: Evadidos is set in an alternate 1980s Portugal where a repressive, authoritarian dictatorship took over much of the world following World War II. The plot follows a protagonist living in the shadows who helps dissidents escape the oppressive regime.
title: Evadidos

overview: A mature woman—who possesses the withdrawn personality of a 14-year-old due to the psychological abuse inflicted by her controlling mother—breaks free from her emotional shackles when she embarks on an unexpected journey and meets a distinguished doctor who helps her discover her true worth.
title: Pobre Clara

overview: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly ""see"" each other, they have already fallen in love. But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?
title: Till I See You

overview: Cristián and the beautiful Pasquense Vaitea decide to get married, but numerous obstacles stand in the way of their happiness, the most important of which is the return of Cristián's father, Fernando Balbontín, who escaped from Rapa Nui 15 years earlier accused of a crime he did not commit.
title: Iorana

overview: Amor Descarado is a Telemundo telenovela that tells the story of twin brothers separated at birth—leading completely opposite lives—who accidentally swap identities.
title: Amor Descarado

overview: Mayor Odorico Paraguaçu—a corrupt politician full of schemes—has made the inauguration of the local cemetery the top priority of his administration in the fictional town of Sucupira, on the coast of Bahia, deciding to follow the example set by his father, Odorico I. He is fawned over by his stuttering secretary, Dirceu Borboleta—an expert on lepidoptera—and enjoys the unconditional support of the Cajazeira sisters, his political allies and fervent defenders: Doroteia, Dulcineia, and Judiceia.
title: O Bem-Amado

overview: A staple part of children's programming throughout the eighties, Dramarama provided an early showcase for some of Britain's most accomplished screenwriters, directors and performers. This unique anthology series presented a distinctive and eclectic mix of drama from whimsical comedy to surrealistic fantasy, from supernatural fable to hard-hitting contemporary realism.
title: Dramarama

overview: Lo que es el amor follows the lives, conflicts, and diverse romantic perspectives of a group of men and women in Mexico City who seek to understand the true meaning of romantic relationships.
title: Lo que es el amor

overview: For years, Ana lives as an undervalued servant to her overbearing mother, Mariana, completely unaware that her real biological mother was actually Mariana's deceased sister, Victoria. When a compassionate aunt gifts her a life-changing vacation, Ana meets a man who falls in love with her sweet nature. This romance triggers a complete personal and physical transformation, forcing her to return home and fight back against her mother's attempts to destroy her newfound happiness.
title: Dulce Ana

overview: The daily life of a young couple—filled with humor and arguments—revolving around the eternal questions of male-female relationships, ranging from the toothpaste tube to the challenges of marriage.
title: Szeret, nem szeret

overview: Two ambitious professionals navigating the cutthroat corporate world find their competitive dynamic shifting into deep personal tension and unexpected romance as they confront hidden feelings and workplace boundaries.
title: Love Warriors

overview: Gustavo accepts the mission of winning over Catarina, a young feminist who loathes men and marriage in exchange for a fortune offered by her father.
title: A Indomável

overview: This nostalgic series, shedding light on 1990s Turkey, offers a heartwarming family atmosphere. Şaşıfelek Çıkmazı, the main setting for most of the series, is a place filled with people leading simple yet colorful lives, including a grocer, butcher, snack bar owner, and more. Inci, who returned to Şaşıfelek Çıkmazı years after leaving her family, opens a new chapter in her life with the friendly neighborhood residents she's known since childhood. A humorous drama about intimate neighborhood relationships in an old neighborhood in Istanbul.
title: Şaşıfelek Çıkmazı

overview: La pobre Clara revolves around Clara Escobar, a woman caught in a gray and submissive life. Marked by the rejection of her own family, Clara is treated practically as a servant by her authoritarian and selfish mother, living isolated from the world, withdrawn and with a destroyed self-esteem . The break point occurs when Clara makes a trip to Europe. There she meets Dr. Christian Carriel, an affable man who sees beyond her sloppy appearance and extreme shyness. Christian sincerely falls in love with her, teaching her to value herself .Throughout history, Clara goes through a radical transformation: she leaves behind her fears, frees herself from the family yoke and returns to become a confident, elegant and willing woman to fight for her own happiness and love.
title: La pobre Clara

overview: Inspired by the stories of the legendary character Herodotus Cevdet, this series is a continuation of the beloved Ekmek Teknesi (The Bread Boat). Blending comedy and drama, Herodotus is famous for the stories he tells every evening in the neighborhood coffeehouse. No matter the time period in which they take place, his tales are told as if they happened just hours ago. His nickname comes from Herodotus, one of the oldest known historians.
title: Heredot Cevdet Saati

overview: Mexican comedian Eugenio Derbez showcases his comedic versatility through a fast-paced variety show filled with humorous sketches, recurring eccentric characters, short jokes, and special guest appearances.
title: Al derecho y al Derbez

overview: Painting a heartwarming family portrait featuring the baker Nusret Baba, his wife Ayhan Hanım, and their delightful daughters, Ekmek Teknesi (The Bread Boat) chronicles the lives, joys, sorrows, struggles, and romances of a modest, unassuming middle-class neighborhood. Set in one of Istanbul's most vibrant neighborhoods—populated by characters like Heredot Cevdet, Ruhi the hardware store owner, the barber, Kirli, and Cengiz—the series blends charming, heartfelt stories with humor. Baker Nusret Efendi has five daughters... He leads a happy, contented life with his wife and five girls... For years, Nusret Efendi and his wife Ayhan Hanım have served as the neighborhood's parental figures... Everyone in the neighborhood trusts Nusret Efendi's words and holds him in high regard... The local community is made up of charming and eccentric individuals... While each has their own amusing story and life, their defining bond is that they live together... *Ekmek Teknesi* is the tale of an old Istanbul neighborhood—a story that, while fictional, is so beautiful one wishes it were real...
title: Ekmek Teknesi

overview: Timmy and Vicki is a two-part play about two young teenagers navigating their first serious relationship, with each episode told from one of their points of view.
title: Timmy and Vicki

overview: The gentle humor of old-fashioned family doctor Joe Bogert.
title: Doc

overview: Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower. Dan and Suzie seek clues in spectacular castles and palaces across Britain and rest of Europe, gain rare access to archives, and reveal new evidence that helps expose the truth behind the executions. Were these iconic figures architects of their own downfall or casualties of ruthless political power plays? The series combines cinematic storytelling with cutting-edge research as we reassess some of the Tudor era's most notorious, controversial and misunderstood individuals. If you want to understand the Tudors, get to know who they executed - and why.
title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads

overview: Japan is famous for its rich traditions and futuristic cities, but it is also a nation bursting with unbelievable wildlife. On this journey from the archipelago's harsh winters through the summer mating season, meet endemic species like bears, raccoons, crabs, flying squirrels, foxes and eagles. Witness never-before-seen footage of Japanese cranes' courting ritual, the spawning of the endangered Japanese giant salamander, battles between Ezo sables, and the flight of the Sika deer.
title: Japan's Wild Side

overview: In July 2024, the discovery of two suitcases containing human remains on Bristol's iconic Clifton Suspension Bridge shocked the nation and sparked one of the UK's most disturbing murder investigations in recent memory. The Bodies on the Bridge follows the investigation from the moment police are alerted to a man wheeling a heavy suitcase across a bridge in the early hours of the morning. When officers discover human remains inside two abandoned suitcases, detectives launch an urgent hunt to identify the victims and track down the person responsible. With unprecedented access to the court proceedings, investigators, police officers, journalists and friends connected to the case, the two-part special explores the murders of Albert Alfonso and Paul Longworth and uncovers their complex relationship with Yostin Mosquera, who was found guilty of the murders of the pair.
title: The Bodies on the Bridge

overview: Operation Homeland takes viewers inside ICE operations across America, following officers as they track violent offenders, fugitives, and national security threats. With unprecedented access, the series captures high-risk arrests, border operations and the growing challenges officers face, revealing the people, pressure and consequences behind one of America's most controversial missions.
title: Operation Homeland

overview: A TV show that presents dramatic stories where the viewer has the opportunity to call the TV station and choose the ending of the story, since there were always two filmed endings. Different hosts through the years would present the situation the viewers were about to see, then display the network numbers so they would pick their favorite ending to the plot.
title: Você Decide

overview: The unethical plastic surgeon Felipe Barreto, married out of interest to Stella, daughter of the wealthy businessman Herculano Maciel, feels a strong attraction to Márcia, a simple, shy, suburban teacher, engaged to Walter, an employee at his clinic. This fascination increases when he discovers that the girl is a virgin. In order to make love to the girl before her fiancé, he arranges for Walter to distance himself and seduces Márcia when she seeks him out. In fact, the girl, before her wedding night, ends up surrendering to Felipe, which causes her life to fall apart, which makes her dedicate herself solely to revenge against the doctor.
title: O Dono do Mundo

overview: Innocent farm worker Sassá Mutema becomes the town hero and a political candidate after he's wrongfully accused of murdering a famous radio broadcaster who used his radio program to deceive and manipulate his listeners.
title: O Salvador da Pátria

overview: The choice of a new city name ignites political conflict in a small town where many of the citizens display unusual, strange abilities - such as a man with wings, a werewolf professor and a woman who literally blows up for overeating.
title: Saramandaia

overview: After being presumed dead, a messianic figure returns to the small city he once helped to defend from a criminal mob, shaking everyone's lives up.
title: Roque Santeiro

overview: Resplendor, in the Northeastern hinterland, was the stage for political disputes between the Pontes and the Batista families. This rivalry led to a complicated web of love, betrayal, and hidden secrets among its members over the years.
title: Pedra Sobre Pedra

overview: A spoiled feminist, daughter of a rich father, even though she doesn't admit it, falls in love with a rustic farmer whom she marries.
title: O Cravo e a Rosa

overview: Raquel Lomelí, a beautiful and cultured young woman, gets ahead without her father's help. She works as an associate at the Lara and Lomelí agency. During an earthquake she meets Román Ortega and he falls in love with her, but what he doesn't know is that Raquel is the daughter of Emiliano Lomelí, "El Tiburon": a cold and unscrupulous man who has stripped engineer Jorge Lara of his property and health, a man whom Roman admires in every way, without knowing that he is actually his father.
title: Hombre tenías que ser

overview: Every chapter takes a different case, all related to what women go through in life, their experiences, their decisions and how sometimes women silence themselves when they are abused, or sometimes they abuse their children for the wrong reasons.
title: Lo que callamos las mujeres

overview: An updated and amped-up take on the massive series "I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!" the series is set in a dense and unforgiving jungle, pairing celebrities with a non-famous friend or family member in the ultimate test of friendship.
title: Get Me Out of Here

overview: After the death of her mother, a determined young Chicana woman relocates from Los Angeles to Mexico alongside her ailing sister to claim a rightful inheritance, only to become entangled in an unexpected web of romance and elite family drama.
title: Victoria

overview: Relationships of neighbours living in an apartment in Istanbul.
title: Bizimkiler

overview: Sketches and gags of various genres of humor, such as black, urban, white, double sense and dawn. Without ridiculing, offending or ridiculing anyone. A program for the whole family that also addressed issues of general interest.
title: La hora pico

overview: A couple in their mid-thirties navigates everyday life, proving that opposite views on minor problems lead to funny arguments and a deep, lasting love.
title: Da dragi da draga

overview: Tenías que ser tú centers on Marisa, a determined single mother who moves to Mexico City, where her life takes a romantic turn after she meets a man who becomes the father her daughter always wanted.
title: Tenías que ser tú

overview: The story follows Gabriela Beltrán, whose life changes dramatically after the tragic death of her father leaves her family in poverty. As she and her family struggle to rebuild their lives, Gabriela falls in love with her childhood friend, Gorka Charachaga. Their romance is threatened by Santa, an ambitious young woman determined to separate them, leading to a story of love, sacrifice, and perseverance in the face of adversity.
title: Tenías que ser tú

overview: Every weekday, Renze Klamer discusses the day's news from the Netherlands and abroad with relevant guests. The show combines current topics, thought-provoking conversations, and a friendly, relaxed atmosphere.
title: Renze

overview: Minute to Win It was a game show where people would compete in stunts to win $250,000. They could include pulling all the tissues out of a box with one hand, stacking golf balls, but they all featured household items.
title: Minute to Win It

overview: Hello there! It's me, Harry Hill! I've got a new show, and this time, it's visualised, A VODSCARF. Join me, my son Gary and Sarah the A.I Bot as we talk to a motley crew of comedians, celebrities and cultural icons, and if that wasn't enough we all learn together as we speak to an expert on stuff like the big bang, day of the dead, and even FLIES as part of our theme of the week! PLUS introducing the game everyone is talking about, Name The Seed
title: The Harry Hill Show

overview: Namthap, a successful young idol unexpectedly reunites with his missing ex-boyfriend, Karant, and is determined not to let him go a second time.
title: My Ex-boyfriend Is An Idol

overview: The young and beautiful Lesya has a rare gift: she can heal people, curing even those illnesses that modern medicine cannot handle. Lesya's gift is hereditary: both her late mother and her grandmother, with whom Lesya lives in an old village house, were healers. One day, a wealthy businessman, Arkady, arrives in the village, having given up hope of curing his injury. Lesya cures his illness. Arkady and Lesya fall in love with each other, and Arkady proposes to the girl. It would seem that Lesya's fate has been happily resolved: a life in the city, in a luxurious apartment, with a loving husband… But Lesya's grandmother is in despair. She is the only one who knows: Lesya's gift will be lost in the city.
title: Знахарка

overview: Four women who grew up in an orphanage reunite after many years with one common goal; to take revenge on the man who abused them when they were little girls.
title: Τι ψυχή θα παραδώσεις μωρή;

overview: Konstadinos Markoras is a director who owns a high profile drama school. Marina Kountouratou is a beautiful woman who hosts a silly television show. Seeking to improve her image, Marina decides to go for studies at Konstadino's school, so that people will stop thinking she's a dumb blonde. Konstadinos doesn't welcome the crazy girl at his school and soon tension begins to raise between them.
title: Δύο Ξένοι

overview: Thodoris Atheridis and Dimitra Papadopoulou are back with new web episodes of "I Love You, You Love Me," every Thursday at 3:00 p.m., exclusively on COSMOTE's YouTube channel. The beloved next-door couple is back—and they're totally digital! Where are Dimitra and Thodoris 17 years later? Are they still together? Do they have kids? What's their relationship with technology and social media? If you loved the TV series, then don't miss its online adaptation!
title: S' agapo - M' agapas

overview: Alekos falls in love with a married woman, Flora, and therefore his wife is tempted to kill him. Meanwhile, many other figures are entering the plot, who is totally unsuspected or maybe not.
title: Εγκλήματα

overview: Dimitris Pavlatos is a supervisor trying to improve the conditions in Kalamos female prison, but he falls in love with a prisoner.
title: Οι στάβλοι της Εριέτας Ζαΐμη

overview: A family sitcom concerning a guy next door who falls in love with the wrong girl and is forced to move in with one of the most dysfunctional families ever: The Trambalis. Her father is a con artist, her mother simply adores her ex and is doing all she can to get them back together, her brother is insanely stupid, his kids are constantly trying to escape from the madhouse and her aunt simply wants any man available. The owner of this 4 generations house is the grandfather who's looking for ways to kick them all out of his house, sell it and move to Russia with his young Russian girlfriend.
title: Η οικογένεια βλάπτει

overview: Season 1-3: Three couples in their early thirties, mid forties and mid sixties are in Athens. Season 4: Three couples in their early twenties, mid thirties and mid forties are in Athens and one couple in their mid sixties is in Crete. Season 5: Two couples in their early thirties and mid forties are in Athens, one couple in their early forties is in Thessaloniki and one couple in their mid sixties is in Crete. Also one extra couple in the Cypriot edition. Season 6: One couple in their thirties is in Athens, two in their forties - one in Thessaloniki and one in Pirgos - and one in their sixties in Crete. Also two extra couples in the Cypriot edition. Season 7-8-9: One couple in their thirties is in Athens, two in their forties - one in Thessaloniki and one in Pirgos - and one in their sixties in Crete. The Cypriot stories were concluded after two years by the end of the sixth season.
title: Μην αρχίζεις τη μουρμούρα

overview: Leonidas is a high-school student who hates studying and enjoys rebel life. How can he and his friends and girlfriend cope with his divorced parents and meddling grandmother, who just can't help interfering in her lives?
title: Δέκα Λεπτά Κήρυγμα

overview: The Mad Monk wanders the mortal realm, guiding and saving those in need, only to find himself trapped in a fateful love tribulation. When he reunites with a woman from his past, the two are drawn into a tangled struggle of love and hatred as demonic forces unleash chaos upon the world. Between the playful daily life of Lingyin Temple and a deadly clash between the divine and the demonic, he must see through greed, anger, delusion, and delusive thoughts. Amid joys and sorrows, partings and reunions, he battles the forces of evil to restore peace to the mortal world.
title: The Mad Monk: Subdue Demons

overview: This series takes place at the isolated village of Kolokotronitsi, a place where life has stuck some decades ago. When Hara, a young woman from Athens comes to the village and opens a cafe, a conflict occurs between her and the totally conservative mayor, Periandros, who doesn't want the ideals and ethic of his village to be destroyed. On the 4th season the series concentrates in the love of Hara's daughter and Periandros' son and the opening of the new cafe.
title: Το καφέ της Χαράς

overview: A charming young priest arrives in a small town, hiding secrets. His true purpose remains unknown until the powerful local leader's daughter unexpectedly becomes his greatest challenge.
title: Άγιος Έρωτας

overview: Chief disciple Zhao Feiyang possesses the legendary "Nine Heavens Codex." When the Nether Hall wipes out the Heavenly Sword Sect, his meridians are shattered, and his fiancée even rips out his Dao bone and breaks off their engagement. At his darkest hour, he saves Bai Xi, an ancient demon saint, who grants him a saint-grade Dao bone, allowing him to cultivate again. Rising at an astonishing pace, he sets out to settle his old scores and found his own sect. A demonic sword recognizes him as its master, and even Earth Immortals submit to him. When the great tribulation finally descends, Zhao Feiyang stands defiant against fate and declares, "If Heaven demands that I face this tribulation, then I'll stain the heavens with blood!"
title: Sword God

overview: Three special dads, Nikos, Dimitris and Iraklis, meet every day at the entrance of the kindergarten where they drop off their children, and begin to become friends and support each other in the incredible adventure called "fatherhood."
title: Μπαμπά σ'αγαπώ!

overview: Paul and Daphne are a modern couple trying to solve all their problems without realizing that, if they ever did, life would be of no particular interest. times brings them to the brink of separation. But this couple together does not and apart can not! They separate, they find each other again, they separate again and the story goes on. As if their own problems were not enough, around them their families, their friends and their bosses, who despite their good intentions, create the biggest confusions.
title: Σ'αγαπάω μεν... αλλά

overview: Four men meet in kindergarten with their children and share their stories and experiences as fathers in a world dominated by women.
title: Queridos Papás

overview: Three very different parents meet day after day at the door of a kindergarten, each have different difficulties. By sharing their experiences together they form a close friendship.
title: Sres. Papis

overview: As one of the world's top actors, Hollywood superstar Idris Elba has the world at his feet. An experienced driver, he does all his own stunts, and is no stranger to a dramatic and high-speed car chase. But what fans may not realise is that Idris has secretly harboured a life-long passion to enter the thrilling world of motorsports. Discovery's brand new four-part series, Idris Elba: No Limits follows him as he pushes himself to the max to master some of the toughest speed disciplines in the world, before taking to both land and air to participate in some of the most fiercely fought competitions in sport. Since he was a little boy, Idris has been fascinated by speed, his passion fuelled by his father's job at the Ford factory in Dagenham, where he later worked himself. But being a speed freak is not enough. To succeed in these fields, Idris must learn four completely different skill sets: skills that it usually takes years to master. Along the way, he will test his body, mind and courage to the absolute limit, before pitting himself against professionals. He will be helped by incredible mentors in each of the four disciplines: rally driving, aerobatics, drag racing, and land speed records. Along the way he will have to find and modify the right vehicles. And it's not smooth sailing: he has to contend with a variety of issues including bad weather, claustrophobia, a fear of heights, potholes and multiple technical problems. For Idris, taking part is not enough. He is entering each competition with just one thing in mind: a hunger to win. No Limits will show Idris Elba as you have never seen him before. Armed with no experience but an abundance of courage, grit, and determination, Idris Elba: No Limits captures every high and low as he takes on the biggest challenge of his life.
title: Idris Elba: No Limits

overview: Two families in conflict. An endless cycle of blood continues and the old vendetta wakes up like a nightmare. The memory of the dead demands revenge. Words have never had enough power to describe such extreme emotions. And somewhere there two young people experiencing love, come face to face with their feelings. Could love bring about reconciliation, the coveted "Jasmine"?
title: Σασμός

overview: Eva, a Greek-Romanian girl with a psychological speech impediment. Her world is shattered when a tragic accident claims the lives of her parents. Left with no one but her estranged grandfather, Lukas.
title: Έρημη Χώρα

overview: It is a Mexican series that shares real stories that have been sent to Silvia Pinal, the host of the show; the episodes deal with strong issues surrounding women that don't always end well.
